comment: Lysine chlorination at the γ-carbon to produce 4-Cl-lysine. Cross-reference to MIBiG entry BGC0001994 cannot be established since the latter refers to a RefSeq ID.

reactions.description: Chlorination at the C4 position of L-lysine by BesD.
BesD catalyses the conversion of L-lysine into 4-chloro-L-lysine.
